newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends up vs dlr boosted by mark's strength.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends up vs dlr boosted by mark's strength.

text.p: Hungary's forint was boosted by the mark's gains against the dollar on Friday and finished firmer versus the U.S. currency, dealers said.
"The forint has been going up (against the dollar) since the opening," said Unicbank's Gabor Butor.
The forint closed at 180.75/80 to the dollar, up from a quote of 181.00/05 at the opening.
The Hungarian currency remained pinned to the National Bank of Hungary's (NBH) resistance level, dealers said.
The NBH fixed the forint at 180.95 to the dollar, up from 181.54 on Thursday.
(NBH floating intervention range: 4.5 percent wide. NBH currency basket: 30 percent dollar + 70 percent mark.)
